verdict_text:
NO

The second task vector is computed against the already-merged intermediate, not the unmodified base: the script forms `tmp = b + 0.4*(f1 - b)` and then adds `0.4*(f2 - tmp)` instead of `0.4*(f2 - b)`. This yields `b + 0.4*(f1-b) + 0.4*(f2-b) - 0.16*(f1-b)`, which differs from the required formula by `0.16*(f1 - b)` and will exceed the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance wherever ft1 changed the tensor. This violates Required result step 2 (and the ordering hazard called out in "Why it is meaningful"). The verification, merged-count, and 244-tensor checks are otherwise present and correct.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
